description.content:
<!-- https://commonmark.org/help/ 
https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/
-->
Creates a new Location object in the Compliance Model, optionally by copying the structure from another Location to the new Location. Supported object types are Division, Facility (Program), Unit (Element), and Point of Interest. This API does not support historical custom fields (those with Track Value History enabled).



envianceSdk.UOM.createUOMCategory
```
[
  {
    "name": "Name",
    "alternateName": "alternateName",
    "namelocalized": [
      {
        "value": "name",
        "culture": "en-us"
      }
    ],
    "alternateNamelocalized": [
      {
        "value": "alternateName",
        "culture": "en-us"
      }
    ]
  },
  "onsuccess",
  "onerror"
]
```
envianceSdk.UOM.createUOM
```
[
  {
    "name": "name",
    "alternateName": "alternateName",
    "categoryIDorName": "BF1D8655-B7D6-4674-90F4-3677B2DB55CA",
    "namelocalized": [
      {
        "value": "name",
        "culture": "en-us"
      }
    ],
    "alternateNamelocalized": [
      {
        "value": "alternateName",
        "culture": "en-us"
      }
    ],
    "uomHistory": [
      {
        "beginDate": "2024-10-01T00:00:00",
        "endDate": "2024-10-31T00:00:00",
        "uomFactor": 1.2
      }
    ]
  },
  "onsuccess",
  "onerror"
]
```

header.description: Specify specific system to run instead of Home
(optional) Clients application/package ID
Udfs of DateTime should use Iso
(obsolete) Udfs of DateTime type whould be in ReadInUserTz
(optional) Udfs - Force Non-Localized (invariant) values

(optional) Client ID for double submit prevention
